    public class ModernPaymentCalendar implements PaymentCalendar {
        private static final ZoneId WARSAW = ZoneId.of("Europe/Warsaw");
        private static final DateTimeFormatter DATE_FORMAT = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE;
        private static final DateTimeFormatter INSTANT_FORMAT = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_OFFSET_DATE_TIME;

            MonthDay.of(Month.JANUARY, 6),

            MonthDay.of(Month.MAY, 3),
            MonthDay.of(Month.AUGUST, 15),

            MonthDay.of(Month.NOVEMBER, 11),
            MonthDay.of(Month.DECEMBER, 25),
            MonthDay.of(Month.DECEMBER, 26)
        );

        @Override
        public boolean isBusinessDay(String date) {
            LocalDate d = parseLocalDate(date);
            return isBusinessDay(d);
        }

        private boolean isBusinessDay(LocalDate d) {
            DayOfWeek dow = d.getDayOfWeek();
            if (dow == DayOfWeek.SATURDAY || dow == DayOfWeek.SUNDAY) return false;
            return !HOLIDAYS.contains(MonthDay.from(d));
        }

        @Override
        public String processingDate(String submittedAt) {
            ZonedDateTime zdt = parseZonedDateTime(submittedAt).withZoneSameInstant(WARSAW);
            LocalDate localDate = zdt.toLocalDate();
            LocalTime localTime = zdt.toLocalTime();

            if (isBusinessDay(localDate) && !localTime.isAfter(LocalTime.of(16, 0, 0))) {
                return localDate.format(DATE_FORMAT);
            } else {
                return nextBusinessDay(localDate).format(DATE_FORMAT);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public String settlementDate(String submittedAt) {
            ZonedDateTime zdt = parseZonedDateTime(submittedAt).withZoneSameInstant(WARSAW);
            LocalDate processingDate = processingDateFromZdt(zdt);
            return nextBusinessDay(processingDate).format(DATE_FORMAT);
        }

        private LocalDate processingDateFromZdt(ZonedDateTime zdt) {
            LocalDate localDate = zdt.toLocalDate();
            LocalTime localTime = zdt.toLocalTime();
            if (isBusinessDay(localDate) && !localTime.isAfter(LocalTime.of(16, 0, 0))) {
                return localDate;
            } else {
                return nextBusinessDay(localDate);
            }
        }

        @Override
        public int daysLate(String dueDate, String paidAt) {
            LocalDate due = parseLocalDate(dueDate);
            LocalDate paid = parseZonedDateTime(paidAt).withZoneSameInstant(WARSAW).toLocalDate();
            long days = ChronoUnit.DAYS.between(due, paid);
            return (int) Math.max(0, days);
        }

        @Override
        public String addMonths(String date, int months) {
            LocalDate d = parseLocalDate(date);
            boolean isLastDay = d.getDayOfMonth() == d.lengthOfMonth();
            LocalDate result = d.plusMonths(months);
            if (isLastDay) {
                result = result.withDayOfMonth(result.lengthOfMonth());
            }
            return result.format(DATE_FORMAT);
        }

        private LocalDate parseLocalDate(String date) {
            try {
                return LocalDate.parse(date, DATE_FORMAT);
            } catch (DateTimeParseException e) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(e);
            }
        }

        private ZonedDateTime parseZonedDateTime(String instant) {
            try {
                return ZonedDateTime.parse(instant, INSTANT_FORMAT);
            } catch (DateTimeParseException e) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(e);
            }
        }

        private LocalDate nextBusinessDay(LocalDate from) {
            LocalDate next = from.plusDays(1);
            while (!isBusinessDay(next)) {
                next = next.plusDays(1);
            }
            return next;
        }
    }
